Behind him, a medium-tempo, upbeat synth-pop BGM plays with a clear rhythmic pulse. The acoustics are clean, reflecting a studio environment with no background noise. (2) As the narration continues, the male voice maintains a friendly and persuasive tone. A subtle transition occurs when he mentions a brand name, but the BGM remains continuous. (3) A significant shift occurs as a female voice enters, speaking clear, enunciated English with a professional teaching tone. The male voice responds in English with a slightly higher pitch and more hesitant delivery. The BGM ducks slightly to allow the dialogue to remain prominent. (4) The audio transitions back to the male voice narrating in Mandarin. His energy increases towards the end of the clip, peaking during the call to action. It uses the host's personal travel story in Spain as a 'hook' to demonstrate the importance of English proficiency, then provides a demonstration of the platform's 1-on-1 teaching style to build trust and conclude with a giveaway incentive.
